admission.justification: The composition, selector and isolated frame must agree on the retained revision shown so comparison cannot borrow another revision’s identity.

applicability: The dashboard Explanation reading view for saved, absent, building, unavailable, retired and compared revision states.
conditions: State/revision routes supply the selected retained revision and its admitted binding.
The developer presses a write control for any update, regeneration or removal.
exclusions: No new claim is made that this UI validates readiness or frame bytes; backend frame-store/readiness invariants own publication.
Frame message prechecks reject supplied mismatches; optional absent identity fields are still forwarded to the host validator.

evidence: dashboard/src/panels/review/explainer/ExplanationView.test.tsx::opens in one isolated frame with no model: a channel for its revision and nothing else; dashboard/src/panels/review/explainer/RevisionSelector.test.tsx::at the task total, names the refusal and offers only unpinned revisions; dashboard/src/panels/review/explainer/ReviewExplainerIntegration.test.tsx::mounts ExplanationSwitch in the top line, renders ExplanationView with tree and chat outside, and selects the exact claim block on return; source-location and unchanged-byte audit: helpers/frontend/source-drift-current-W9.json; no fresh test execution.

MIK-R106 v2 rule 6: compare opens two retained revisions in isolated frames; existing INV-YY035T unchanged statement/scope. Source-only pin/slot branch inspection supplements the named integration assertion; no separate proof is claimed for every malformed pin or slot collision.

statement: The Review | Explanation switch replaces only the review reading body, and each shown or compared saved revision displays its own binding, time and claim-basis labels while opening a separate isolated host channel without starting a model.
